goal: Store a whist (Americano) design for 57 players, the last 4k/4k+1 size up to 64 without one.
notes: Construction: D = {0,1,3,13,32,36,43,52} in Z57 is a Singer difference set, so its translates are the lines of PG(2,7). The stored Wh(8) (Z7+inf) is seated on D by a random bijection. The base round is its 14 tables, each shifted by t_i, chosen by dancing links so they partition Z57\{0}. Development puts the shifted Wh(8) on every line, so every pair partners once and meets twice. Page effect, 57 players on 14 courts: repeat partners 87 -> 0, pairs never partnered 87 -> 0, opponent meetings 0-5 -> exactly 2; build 300 ms -> 9 ms. Verification: node --test whist.test.mjs 20/20 pass; whist-bases-build re-checked every stored size, all ok; run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator: ok, 766 tests, 283 s; venture-preflight.mjs: clean (exit 0).
